# Vocabulary illustrations

The original 130 game illustrations are retained. The additional 370 SVG illustrations are from [OpenMoji](https://openmoji.org/), an open-source project by HfG Schwäbisch Gmünd and its contributors, under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

Source: https://github.com/hfg-gmuend/openmoji/tree/master/color/svg

The SVGs are bundled locally in `word-art.js`; XML declarations and comments were removed for inline use. The artwork remains licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. This artwork licence does not change the licence of the game code or the original illustrations. `word-library.js` maps vocabulary to the source hexadecimal artwork identifiers.
